# HAPI-Rust (Overbaker/hapi-rust)

> Open-source, local-first remote control and Rust session wrapper for AI coding agents (Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, Antigravity, Pi, OpenCode, Cursor Agent). Fork of `tiann/hapi` engineered to run 100+ concurrent local agent sessions per machine at ~4.4 MiB wrapper RAM per session, with automatic 24-hour idle session hibernation and browser/PWA remote control.

## Disambiguation

- **HAPI-Rust** (`https://github.com/Overbaker/hapi-rust`) is an AI coding agent remote-control platform and Rust session wrapper (`crates/hapi-wrapper-core`, `crates/hapi-session-wrapper`), forked from `tiann/hapi` under AGPL-3.0.
- It is **unrelated** to `alexxbb/hapi-rs` (SideFX Houdini Engine Rust API bindings).
- Unlike upstream `tiann/hapi` (which remains TypeScript/Bun-only per `tiann/hapi#2534`), HAPI-Rust ships a native Rust `hapi-session-wrapper` binary with automatic TypeScript fallback and automatic idle session hibernation.

## Key Verified Benchmarks

- **Production Linux hosts (2026-11-21, 29 live sessions, wrapper PSS only)**:
  - Rust wrapper (`claude`, `codex`, `agy`, 10 sessions): **4.4 MiB median** (range 2.2–6.5 MiB)
  - TypeScript/Bun wrapper (`claude`, `codex`, `agy`, `pi`, 19 sessions): **83.7 MiB median** (range 45.8–242.0 MiB)
  - Reduction: **~19× lower median memory per session**.
- **Controlled 10-session benchmark (HTTPS loaded: 30 turns, ~1 MB JSONL, 1 live PTY)**:
  - Compiled TS wrapper: 101.7 MiB RSS / 55.1 MiB PSS / 50.5 MiB USS; spawn-to-webhook p50/p95 = **277 / 291 ms**
  - Rust wrapper: 8.6 MiB RSS / **2.07 MiB PSS** / 1.53 MiB USS; spawn-to-webhook p50/p95 = **12 / 15 ms**
- **Parity**: 62/62 transcript parity checks passing across 18 recorded Claude Code scenarios (`cli/src/parity`).

## Supported Platforms & Agents

- **Linux x64 & Linux arm64**: Native Rust wrapper for Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity, and Pi (experimental).
- **Windows x64**: Native Rust wrapper for Codex.
- **macOS & other flavors**: Transparent automatic fallback to TypeScript wrapper.
- **Idle Hibernation**: Auto-hibernates idle sessions after 24 hours (`HAPI_SESSION_HIBERNATE_MS`) and wakes on the next message for Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Pi, and Antigravity (`agy acp`).

- [Supported Agents](https://overbaker.github.io/hapi-rust/guide/agents): Supported coding agents and modes
